turns.question: What should I cook tonight in Pretoria for two? I have about an hour and I shop at PnP. Give me the recipe and what it'll cost.
turns.answer:
I'm handing this to my cook; he'll be back shortly with a dinner for two.My kok is terug, hier is wat hy gekry het:

### The dish
Chicken curry with potatoes, onion and baby carrots, all cooked in one pot. It takes about 40 minutes, so it fits tonight's hour, and it feeds two from a few cheap, everyday ingredients.

### Recipe
![Maklike Kerrie Hoender Resep](https://idata.hiloved.com/imgs/71c8af47bc3e39b6-1024x681.jpg)

Serves 2 · about 40 minutes

1. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok or deep pan on medium-high. Fry the chopped red onion until soft and see-through.
2. Stir in the curry paste and fry until fragrant. (If you use curry powder instead, add a little water to make a paste.)
3. Add the chicken, cut into pieces about 4 cm, and fry for about 5 minutes until browned and coated in the paste.
4. Add the halved carrots and the potatoes cut into small pieces. Stir for 1 minute.
5. Add the hot stock (1 cup), sugar, salt and white pepper.
6. Cover and simmer on low for 15–20 minutes, until the chicken and potatoes are cooked through. Taste and adjust.
7. Sprinkle with ground coriander if you're using it. Serve with rice or flatbread.

Link: https://af.hiloved.com/maklike-kerrie-hoender-resep/

| Potatoes | 2 medium | potatoes 1 kg | ± R20 |
| Red onion | 1 | red onion, loose, 1 each | ± R8 |
| Baby carrots | 10 | baby carrots 250 g | ± R18 |
| Medium curry paste | 2 tbsp | medium curry paste 200 g | ± R35 |
| **Total** | | | **± R146** |

From the pantry: cooking oil, salt, white pepper, sugar, stock (1 stock cube in 1 cup water) and ground coriander (optional).
